title: India's Inflation Just Hit 6.09% — Your December Rate Cut Is Dead #Shorts
description:
Everyone expected RBI to cut rates in December. India's CPI inflation just hit 6.09% in October 2026 — breaking the RBI's 6% upper tolerance limit. Here's exactly what it means for your EMI, your FD, and your grocery bill.

📊 Key Numbers (MoSPI Oct 2026):
• CPI Inflation: 6.09% (RBI ceiling: 6.00%) — BREACHED
• Food Inflation: 8.94%
• Urban CPI: 5.41% | Rural CPI: 6.63%
• Onion: +116% | Garlic: +61%
• RBI Repo Rate: 5.50% (hiked Oct 7, 2026)
• Next MPC Meeting: Dec 2–4, 2026
